---
name: Defect

## What is wrong
Describe the incorrect behavior or artifact. Include the file path.

## Expected vs actual
What should happen (cite the relevant `spec.md` section), and what happens instead?

## Reproduction
Steps, commands, or the fixture/payload that demonstrates the defect.

## Environment
Python version, dependency versions, OS — if relevant.
